verdict.rationale: The service has its own documented registered-agent mechanism: Form 401 lets a company designate or change its registered agent and office, and it can be filed online through SOSPortal. That is one of the third-party rails the story names. However, the evidence never shows a provider, filer or representative filing or ordering on a company's behalf through SOSPortal accounts, so the delegated-action rail is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented filer/representative or authorized-provider delegation in SOSPortal, account-level designee permissions, detail on what a registered agent may do for the company, independent corroboration.
